card.name: Slash and unit words after a 1
card.fires_on: The word or mark right after a numeral 1 in a ratio or rate, such as the slash in (1/212) or per, hour and milliliter in per-unit phrases.

modes.label: Slash in patient fractions
modes.description: The slash after 1 in a count of patients, such as (1/212), given after a percentage.

modes.label: Per-unit wording
modes.description: The word per, or the unit word that follows it, in a ratio or concentration.

card.plain: It marks the spot right after a 1 where a ratio or denominator is about to come, as in 1/212 or 1 per 500.
